mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId , nickname AS nickName , email , created_at AS createdAt , bio , invite_code AS inviteCode , board.boardCount AS boardCount , board.boardLike AS boardLike , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM follow WHERE follow.follower_id = #{userId}) AS followingCount , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM follow WHERE follow.following_id = #{userId}) AS followerCount , profile.profilePath AS profilePath , profile.backgroundPath AS backgroundPath FROM users users LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id AS userId , COUNT(*) AS boardCount , COALESCE(SUM(like_count), 0) AS boardLike FROM board WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY user_id ) board ON board.userId = users.user_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id AS userId , MAX(CASE WHEN file_type = 0 THEN path END) AS profilePath , MAX(CASE WHEN file_type = 1 THEN path END) AS backgroundPath FROM profile_files WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY user_id) AS profile ON users.user_id = profile.userId WHERE user_id = #{userId}
